verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs describe LangSmith Engine, which automatically detects recurring issues in your traces, diagnoses their root cause and helps resolve them. Reference-free LLM-as-judge evaluators can also run automatically on production traces to assess quality. However, Engine appears only as a single one-line claim, with no detail on how its AI insights or suggestions are generated or shown. missing for 10: detailed docs on Engine's AI-generated insights and suggestions, any in-product natural-language or assistant-style analysis of user data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Automatically detect recurring issues in your traces, diagnose their root cause, and resolve them with LangSmith Engine.
Set up evaluators to run automatically on production traces: safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics, and reference-free LLM-as-judge.
